provenance.method: Rehash the three root manifests and recursively verify SHA256-pinned evidence manifests/containers. Parse only contiguous committed byte columns; independently rehash both complete MOD-associated IDBs and read every interval directly from the uncompressed IDAv6 ID1 low-byte column using Python mmap/struct at four-byte stride. No target code, EXE, disassembler, foreign script, model or callback executes.

provenance.reusePolicy: Complete P0-57/P0-58/P0-61 interval union. Identical source/start/end intervals deduplicated. Different interval widths and overlapping addresses retained and checked for overlap consistency. Unpaired shapes include different-width source functions and are not automatically source-exclusive code. No new machine-byte ranges.
